caseStudy.problem: Python image/video sorting with object detection, OCR, local inference and regression tests for safe file operations.
caseStudy.role: Personal project: implementation, integration and testing.
architecture: A CLI routes images through OCR/object classification and samples video frames for captioning. File operations handle collisions and malformed media; dry-run previews planned moves.
validation: Public source includes documented focused test commands; see the repository validation notes for current results.
limitations: Classification quality is provisional. Audio sorting, undo/journaling and a distributable app are not implemented. Optional model downloads can be large; test first on copies of your files.
